_comment: Edit freely, then press Reload in the panel. Placeholders: {class} {spec} {phase} {guide} {resources}. Optional per-button "mode": default | acceptEdits | plan | bypassPermissions.

buttons.label: Gather sources (Pass 0)
buttons.prompt: Pass 0 for {class} {spec}: go find and download the authoritative sources yourself (Wowhead BiS + pre-raid + phase guides, wowtbc.gg page-data.json, Icy Veins gear/rotation/talents, Warcraft Tavern per-phase BiS). Use curl with a browser UA, not WebFetch. Save every raw response into {resources}/ and update its SOURCES.md with filename, URL, coverage, and date fetched. Do not build anything from memory yet.

buttons.label: Extract & rank (Pass 1)
buttons.prompt: Pass 1 for {class} {spec}: parse ONLY the saved files in {resources}/ and pull out gear per slot per phase. Rank by the source's own ordering (first listed = best). Where sources conflict, keep both and note the split. Output item IDs + rank + slot/phase. Leave Source and Notes rough for now.

buttons.label: Fill Phase {phase} (per-slot)
buttons.prompt:
Break Phase {phase} of {guide} out per gear slot exactly like Phase 1 and Phase 2: intro paragraph (plus a tip-box for set bonuses), then for each slot an

, a

line, and a ranked gear-table with BiS / Alt BiS / Good rows and correct data-source. Add matching nav-sub links per slot. Do not leave it as a flat one-table list.

buttons.label: Talents (grid + leveling)
buttons.prompt: Add or refresh the Talents section in {guide}: build summary, key-talents box, an <h2 id="talent-build"> CSS talent-tree grid, and an <h2 id="talent-leveling"> Leveling Order (1-70) table with main tree first. Pull exact ranks and totals from the wowtbc.gg page-data.json bisTalentOne for {class} {spec}, verify the per-tree totals add up, and add the two nav-sub links.

buttons.label: Scaffold new guide
buttons.prompt: Create a new guide at {guide} using warrior/prot/classguide-warrior-prot.html as the canonical template. Copy its structure, CSS, and scripts verbatim; change only the data and the accent color to the {class} class color. Include every Standard Content Section, with Phases that have no data yet left as "Awaiting data" placeholder tables.

buttons.label: Verify sources (Pass 2)
buttons.prompt: Pass 2 for {guide}: collect every item ID in the file, run `python tools/al_item_source.py <ids>` on them, and fix each Source cell from its output. Nothing from memory. Make the icon, the data-source attribute, and the cell text agree. Anything the tool reports as not in the loot tables is crafted, quest, world-drop, PvP, or a tier token, not a boss drop. For tier pieces, name the boss the TOKEN drops from.

buttons.label: Rewrite notes (Pass 3)
buttons.prompt: Pass 3 for {guide}: run `python tools/wh_item_stats.py <ids>` on every item to verify real stats, then rewrite the Notes column as judgment, not a stat list. A note that restates the tooltip is banned. Each note gives why-this-rank, the trade-off, when to swap, or how to get it, in about one line. No website names.

buttons.label: Run audit (Pass 5)
buttons.prompt: Run `python tools/audit_guide.py {guide}` and fix every hard ERROR until the exit code is clean. Then read each WARN and either fix it or tell me why it is intentional. Show me the final clean run.

buttons.label: Feature checklist (Pass 4)
buttons.prompt: Grep the AI-MANIFEST in warrior/prot/classguide-warrior-prot.html, then check {guide} against every numbered feature in it: tooltips, nav + sub-collapse, scrollspy, mobile hamburger, filter bar, gear tables, table-wrap, sticky headers, source icons, heroic spans, info/tip/warn boxes, gem-enchant blocks, copy-link buttons, projects footer, per-slot phase layout, class switcher, AtlasLoot export, talents. Report what is missing, then add it.

buttons.label: Em-dash sweep
buttons.prompt: Search {guide} for the em dash character (U+2014) and for — and replace every hit with a comma, colon, period, or a rephrase. Report the count before and after.

buttons.label: Register guide everywhere
buttons.prompt: Register {guide} across the site: (a) add its link to the class-guide switcher in EVERY existing guide, with the current guide styled active, (b) add or activate its card on the hub at index.html, and (c) add a <url> entry to the repo-root ../sitemap.xml with changefreq monthly and priority 0.8. Verify the relative paths resolve from each guide's own folder.

buttons.label: Back-port a feature
buttons.prompt: I want to back-port a feature so all guides stay in sync. Ask me which feature, then: add it to the AI-MANIFEST in the prot reference template, add a row to the feature table in wow_class_guides/CLAUDE.md, and apply it to every existing guide. List the files you changed.

buttons.label: Review my diff
buttons.prompt: Run git status and git diff for the guide files, and walk me through what changed. Flag anything that violates the rules in CLAUDE.md: em dashes, Source cells that disagree with their icon or data-source, notes that just restate stats, missing tooltips, or a filled phase left as a flat one-table list. Do not commit.

buttons.label: Commit
buttons.prompt: Run `python tools/audit_guide.py` across all guides first. If it is clean, stage the guide changes and commit them with a short descriptive message. If it is not clean, stop and show me the errors instead.

buttons.label: Item source
buttons.prompt: Ask me for item IDs, then run `python tools/al_item_source.py` on them and give me the correctly formatted Source cell for each, including the icon and the data-source value.

buttons.label: Item stats
buttons.prompt: Ask me for item IDs, then run `python tools/wh_item_stats.py` on them and summarize what each item is actually for in the context of {class} {spec}.

buttons.label: What is missing?
buttons.prompt: Read {guide} and tell me, as a short prioritized list, what is still incomplete or wrong: missing sections, phases still on placeholder tables, empty note cells, slots with no ranked rows, and anything that fails the CLAUDE.md rules. Do not change anything yet.
